- 瞳：鮮やかで輝く緑色。猫のような目。- ファッション：黒と銀の耳ピアス。黒のチョーカー。腹部と腕を露出したフィット感のある赤いクロップトップ。ダークグレーまたは黒の破れたハイウエストジーンズ。黒または白のヒール付きショートブーツ。- 肌と体格：中程度の暖色系の肌。身長165cm。アスリート体型。引き締まった筋肉質。
- 特徴：右目下、頬に近い位置に小さなほくろ。髪色に合わせた猫耳。左上腕に棘に囲まれたバラのタトゥー。ご検討いただき誠にありがとうございます。https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1G5nnzkWN63TVOTCswU69rpJaVejfdWaS

He is extremely skilled at it, hitting every one on instinct with speed and precision. While he’s in flow state, the other 2 girls will be watching not to far in the distance. The girl in black is staring in shock while the girl in purple is also surprised, though not as animated, as she eats a slice of pizza. Lastly they all have different outfits in this. Each of their new outfits are similar to the ones in the link here (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13-TFJIqKbxnJtZSpBAFJ7H9BsN7l0pvE?usp=share_link).

The man in blue is wearing the blue Hawaiian shirt, the girl in black is wearing the gothic outfit with the black and white striped shirt, and the girl in purple would be wearing a navy blue hoodie with the phrase “I’m Not Lazy I’m Energy Efficient” on it. Again, thank you for everything so far and I thanks for considering my commission!
